question: A man spends 50% of his monthly salary on the rent of his house. If every month he also spends ₹780 on his conveyance and ₹9,800 on his groceries and saves the remaining ₹110, his monthly salary is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **Monthly Salary** be 100%.

**Rent** = 50%, so the remaining 50% must cover **Conveyance**, **Groceries**, and **Savings**.

Remaining 50% = ₹780 + ₹9,800 + ₹110 = ₹10,690.

If 50% = ₹10,690, then 100% = ₹10,690 × 2 = ₹21,380.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹21,380.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21c5d0f8909790257189f02675a2658296e3bc4dc04ed96c182e12da61346b5b.png] 

**Given:**

**Rent Expenditure** = 50% of Salary

**Conveyance** = ₹780, **Groceries** = ₹9,800, **Savings** = ₹110

**Formula:** Total Salary = Rent + Conveyance + Groceries + Savings

⇒ Let Total Salary = S

⇒ S = 0.50S + 780 + 9,800 + 110

⇒ S − 0.50S = 10,690

⇒ 0.50S = 10,690

⇒ S = 10,690 ÷ 0.50

⇒ S = ₹21,380

**∴ The correct answer is ₹21,380.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change

When a value is split into percentages, the sum of all parts must equal 100% of the base value.

Savings Formula

Savings = Income − Total Expenditure. In percentage terms: Savings % = 100% − (Sum of all expenditure %).

Successive Percentage

If the question says 'percent of remaining', use the formula: Final = Initial × (1 − r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100).
